NOTE
**Still not ready**

No new push since the feedback. The author says the description was fixed up, and Daniel K confirmed on CZO that this extends the #24200 filters, so the design question is settled. The author also asked for "maintainer review" to be added.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | The design question is settled: Daniel K said on CZO that the PR isn't blocked and fits the #24200 filter UX. |
| ❌  | The description is still messy: "Fixes:" is empty, the later line reads "Fixes #<36878>" with stray brackets, and the summary is a long list of mixed changes. |
| ❌  | The commits don't follow commit discipline: two "ci: Retry/Trigger CI" commits are noise, and the real commit bundles a contenteditable conversion, parsing changes and test fixes into one. |
| ⚠️  | The self-review boxes "Calls out remaining decisions" and "Corner cases" are unchecked. |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and don't add "maintainer review" yet.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for checking in with the design discussion, and good to hear Daniel K confirmed this fits the #24200 filters. Before this can go to review, please fix the description (a proper `Fixes: #36878` line, plus a short summary) and clean up the commits, dropping the CI-retry ones and splitting the work into coherent commits, as described in the [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html). The [reviewable PRs guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/reviewable-prs.html) covers the rest.
```
